status: FIT PROTOTYPE - CONNECTOR SAMPLE NOT MEASURED
coordinate_system: mm; x across port, y inward from flange front reference plane, z above motherboard top; top view has flange towards negative y; male pin 1 is at positive x

motherboard.verification: Nominal manufacturer replacement drawings; verify target motherboard revision and case

pcb.finish: ENIG preferred; finish is a manufacturer order choice

connector_sample_assumptions.note: Only flange reference size/centres and contact grid are sourced; rear body, solder cups, thickness and shape are illustrative pending selected solder-cup part

holder.nut_thread_requirement: Prototype defaults use M3 captive nuts and jackposts with M3 male rear stems / 4-40 UNC female cable-facing threads. HARTING 09670009924 is a candidate, not a frozen BOM item. Match actual nut dimensions and mounting stem; no assumption of M3.5.
holder.note: FIT PROTOTYPE. The printed base has one broad, coplanar Z0 underside with no projecting mounting feet or separate anchor shims. The PCB support plane remains at Z5.75. Motherboard contact, solder-cup connector, material, print fit and insertion strength require physical trials.
holder.anchor_assembly_note: Insert M3 screws upwards with an insulating washer beneath each head and the motherboard; fit nuts directly on the supported adapter-PCB SHIELD mounting pads. Verify the broad base underside sits flat and that the motherboard has no obstructing parts or solder joints beneath it. No default top washer and no separate printed shims.
holder.shell_relief_note: Shallow top recesses under dedicated J4 shell-bond wire holes clear pre-soldered fillets. Route insulated shell wires above PCB, clear of signal pins and cover glue contact areas.
holder.ground_wire_note: The right side of the flat base has an outward-open 1.20mm recessed wire channel, Z0..1.00, beginning at X24.00 on the original shell-pad axis. Pre-solder the deliberate ground lead to the motherboard shell pad, route the insulated lead outwards then up to J4. Actual solder/insulation clearance must be trialled; the wire and fillet must not prevent the base sitting flat.
holder.forward_end_note: Squared end faces at X+/-25.60 from Y0.65 through Y5.10. This fills the former X25 rear-corner cutback by 0.60mm and trims the earlier front X26 face by 0.40mm so the outer end wall is continuous. The nut pocket remains unchanged; outer wall is nominal0.615mm and rear web0.80mm. The neighbouring-lug relief starts behind the end towers at Y5.10 and remains X25 to Y7.50. No new height-dependent neighbour-clearance assumption is introduced.
holder.pin_entry_note: 45-degree conical lead-in on the top 0.40 mm only; diameter 1.72 mm at Z4.50, with the 0.92 mm straight guide below Z4.10. Two layers at 0.20 mm layer height. Trial hand clearing and pin retention on the coupon; hot insertion is not validated.

pin_height_jig.note: Loading only. Two annular pads support the flat base at motherboard datum Z0; the central floor stops all pin tips at Z-3.20. Remove before soldering. Equal top heights require equal measured 10.70mm pin lengths and sufficient guide retention.

mounting.direction: Screw head and insulating washer beneath motherboard; screw upward through base and PCB; nut directly on supported SHIELD pad above adapter PCB
mounting.note: M3x12 under-head default. Mandatory assumed0.50mm insulating washer,OD8/ID3.2, beneath motherboard; default no top washer. Reference-board bareØ7head overlapsforeigncopper. Insulation dimensions, PCB seating and chassisclearance require physical checks. Topwasher optional only after threadengagement/capreview.14/16mm needshortening orreview. No motherboard countersinking/drilling. Deliberate wire bond is required because underside head is insulated.
mounting.compression_sleeve_note: Optional rigid sleeve/stop would require a reviewed bore variant and measured length equal to motherboard-top-to-PCB-underside height (nominal 5.75). No custom sleeve is required by this default prototype. Verify flat seating and use tested light tightening; plastic creep/retention strength remain unverified.

cap.note: Optional cosmetic cover with 1.60 mm roof, short continuous 1.20 mm side/rear rim above mounting nuts, and two broad locating keys. No hooks, thin corner projections or base catch recesses. Apply tiny adhesive spots to the tower top bearing faces only after inspection. Tightened jackposts must retain their nuts without the cover; confirm on actual parts. Glue retention and revised print fit are untested.

observations: Test print shows delicate lid features and missing small projections.
Selected mounting nut lies within the printed footprint in the supplied trial photograph.
physical_observations.limits: No measured hardware dimensions, complete PCB/nut stack, load test or functional electrical result supplied. Revision 0.6 has not yet been printed.
